title: fix(ui): the page designer canvas draws an authored record:details select and location the way the record page does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8FZSndfpnCtDUC82v4JroZg)_
Fixes #27177

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 页面设计器的 Design 画布上,作者写明字段名的 `record:details` 现在把 `select` 显示成选项标签、把 `location` 显示成坐标,不再是原始值 `amer` 和 `[Object]`,与运行时记录页一致。
- 为什么改:画布挂的就是运行时的 `record:details`,但 Studio 不给 dataSource,`DetailView` 只能从 dataSource 拿对象定义,于是只写字段名的条目没有类型,画成原始值;对象定义其实已在画布的记录上下文里。
- 风险与回滚:只在 `recordFromHost` 且 dataSource 尚未答复时借用上下文里的对象定义;有 dataSource 时它的答复照旧优先,不新增任何请求,没有上下文或不走 `recordFromHost` 的 `DetailView` 输出不变(测试钉住);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`(`hostObjectSchema` 那三行)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.authoredDetailsValues-27177.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.authoredDetailsValues-27177.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.hostObjectSchema-27177.test.tsx`,预期 5 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

1. **`DetailView` takes field types from the host's object schema when the host supplies the record.** `DetailView` learned field types only from `dataSource.getObjectSchema`. Under `recordFromHost` (which `record:details` sets) it now reads the record context's `objectSchema` as well, and uses it until a dataSource answer arrives: `objectSchema = dataSourceObjectSchema ?? (recordFromHost ? hostObjectSchema ?? null : null)`. A dataSource answer still wins, nothing new is fetched, no prop is added, and a `DetailView` with no record context, or one that reads its own record, draws as before.
2. **Changeset:** `.changeset/27177-detail-host-object-schema.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`.

## Why

The card's premise holds: on the Design canvas a `full` record page whose `record:details` names its fields drew a `select` as its stored code and a `location` as `[Object]`. The dispatch order assumed a canvas-side value-render site under `views/metadata-admin/previews/`; measuring disproved that. `PagePreview` wraps `PageBlockCanvas` in `RecordContextProvider` with the bound object's `/meta` schema and no dataSource (as every Studio preview does), and the canvas mounts the runtime `record:details` renderer itself, so the triage ruling ("the canvas reuses the runtime's field renderers; it does not get its own formatter") was already true. What the canvas lacked was the field metadata: the full-create seed writes `sections[].fields` as bare names, a bare-name entry carries no `type`, and `DetailSection` resolves the type from `objectSchema`, which stayed null without a dataSource. The slotted default looked right because its synthesized sections carry typed field objects; the record page looked right because it has a dataSource. The seat ruled the route on the card (order amendment 6468231446): fix it in `DetailView`, no new prop, no stub dataSource.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (ESLint on the three changed source and test files: 0 errors; the repo-wide run is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English, except the 维护者速读 section, which the dispatch order requires in Chinese.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.authoredDetailsValues-27177.test.tsx` (2): the full-create seed names its detail fields by bare name (premise pin); on the real Design canvas (real `PageBlockCanvas`, record context, `record:details`, `DetailView` and cell renderers; only the two endpoints `PagePreview` reads are doubled) the bound `record:details` body draws `Americas` for `sales_region: 'amer'` and `37.7749, -122.4194` for a `location`, never `amer` or `[Object]`; CONTROL inside it: a plain `text` field reads as stored.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.hostObjectSchema-27177.test.tsx` (3): with no dataSource, a `recordFromHost` view under a record context draws the option label and the coordinates; CONTROL: with a dataSource, its answer wins over the host schema and is read once (no record read); CONTROL: with no record context, or without `recordFromHost`, the view draws the raw value exactly as before.

## Acceptance notes

- The fix lives in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, outside the order's original file surface; the seat widened the surface to `DetailView.tsx` plus the changeset before the first edit (order amendment 6468231446).
- The controls pin that a `DetailView` with no context still draws a bare-name `select` raw. That is the behaviour of a host that hands no object schema at all, unchanged on purpose.

## Verification

All readings on head `d8123be0` (branch tip after merging `origin/main`) unless noted.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/` under the verify lock: Test Files 150 passed (150); Tests 1683 passed (1683); VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Type check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` each exit 0 (after the closure build `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, VERDICT command-exit 0, and a `@object-ui/plugin-detail` rebuild after the merge).
- ESLint on the three changed files: 0 errors (warnings are the files' existing `any` lines and the test doubles' `as any`, as in the sibling tests).

- `const objectSchema = dataSourceObjectSchema ?? (recordFromHost ? hostObjectSchema ?? null : null);` replaced by `const objectSchema = dataSourceObjectSchema;` turns 2 tests red (the canvas test, the no-dataSource DetailView test); the premise pin and both controls stay green.
